synopsis: ISO 19296:2018 is a published international standard for underground mobile mining machine safety, providing general safety and foreseeable-misuse requirements [f2712, f2191, f15231]. It is not a stand-alone collision-avoidance performance protocol, so its general safety role should not be confused with collision-avoidance performance acceptance [f2193, f15233]. ISO 21815-1:2022 uses ISO 19296 to identify underground mining machines within its scope, while ISO 21815-3:2023 normatively references it alongside ISO 3450 for brakes [f2149, f15232, f2166]. For mining machines outside ISO 6165, the glossary cautions against assuming ISO 19014 applies and says ISO 19296 and generic standards may apply by contract or jurisdiction; applicability therefore remains machine- and context-dependent [f15234].
